cases.question: Why do people feel lonely in crowded cities?
Why do humans seek status and recognition?
How do database indexes trade write speed for read speed?

cases.selected_summary: People quickly return to a stable baseline of happiness after good or bad events.
cases.selected_connection: It explains why chasing a happy peak rarely produces lasting satisfaction.
